purpose: Review a finite issuer export-control, sanctions, trade-remedy, tariff, quota, origin and customs-restriction lifecycle domain before opening source rows, notices, filings, factor values, comparators, security prices or returns.

repository_evidence.subsidy_boundary: Government-subsidy disclosure intensity already has a frozen mechanism audit and data contract. It cannot be renamed as trade-policy support, export promotion or industrial-policy exposure, and was rejected before values as Campaign180's first scout.
repository_evidence.litigation_boundary: CNInfo lawsuit counts were previously deferred and then explicitly closed as a rescue for the terminal guarantee and major-contract transport family. A generic legal-dispute campaign would reopen that consumed source choice, so it was rejected before values as Campaign180's second scout.
repository_evidence.environmental_boundary: Campaign165 freezes environmental permits, emissions and externalities. A border carbon measure may interact with environmental exposure, but international trade jurisdiction, product scope, origin, duty, quota and import or export restriction state are distinct and require their own source chain.
repository_evidence.operational_incident_boundary: Campaign166 freezes product, safety, privacy, cyber and operational incidents. A customs detention or export prohibition is an authority-imposed trade state, not proof of an issuer-caused operational incident or product defect.
repository_evidence.commercial_terms_boundary: Campaign169 freezes product prices, tariffs and sales terms. A commercial price or customer term does not identify a sovereign trade measure, covered product and origin, duty or quota basis, effective interval, exemption, appeal or removal.
repository_evidence.tax_boundary: Campaign173 freezes issuer tax qualification and disputes. Customs duties and trade remedies may collect money at the border, but their product, origin, jurisdiction, investigation, order, quota and licensing lifecycle is not an issuer income-tax state.
repository_evidence.operating_right_boundary: Campaign179 freezes issuer operating licenses and concessions. An export authorization may be one trade-specific permission, but a general business license does not identify sanctioned parties, controlled technology, product and destination scope, trade-remedy orders, tariffs, quotas or customs actions.
repository_evidence.point_in_time_boundary: A current sanctions list, tariff table, customs classification or trade-remedy order cannot be projected backward without proposal, initiation, preliminary and final decision, effective date, scope amendment, exemption, review, suspension, appeal, expiry, revocation, correction and first-public histories.

must_freeze_before_any_formula_or_direct: exact official export-control, sanctions, customs, trade-remedy, tariff or quota authority source, exchange filing or licensed structured source with immutable bytes and stable authority, measure, document and observation identifiers

first-public timestamp, trading-session availability, proposal, investigation, preliminary decision, final order, effective, amendment, review, suspension, expiry, revocation, removal, appeal, correction and supersession timeline

issuer, listed security, parent, subsidiary, affiliate, joint venture, distributor, customer, supplier, beneficial owner, sanctioned party, exporter, importer and legal counterparty mapping without current-state leakage

measure taxonomy separating export control, end-use or end-user restriction, sanctions designation, import ban, export ban, licensing requirement, anti-dumping, countervailing duty, safeguard, tariff, tariff-rate quota, origin ruling, customs detention, seizure and release
jurisdiction, issuing authority, governing instrument, investigation or case number, measure level, legal basis, affected country, destination, origin and direct, secondary or extraterritorial reach
product, commodity, service, software, technology and technical-data identity with stable HS, tariff, ECCN or other classification, version history, unit, grade and product-to-issuer mapping
petition, initiation, questionnaire, sampling, preliminary finding, undertaking, final order, administrative review, sunset review, court appeal and implementation-stage semantics
duty, deposit, tariff, quota, de minimis, licensing, value, volume, currency, unit, allocation, utilization, cap, floor, retrospective assessment and refund semantics
direct issuer exposure versus customer, supplier, product, destination, origin, affiliate and transshipment exposure with revenue, cost, capacity or shipment denominator identity frozen before use

general and specific license, waiver, exemption, exclusion, grandfathering, wind-down, compliance notice, detention, seizure, release, delisting, removal, settlement, appeal and enforcement-outcome semantics

consolidation scope, gross-versus-net presentation, unit and currency, restatement and missing, undisclosed, not-applicable, pending, inactive, zero duty, zero quota, unrestricted, exempt and expired semantics

complete bounded 2019-2023 partition manifest, full-market denominator, issuer, party, product, classification, jurisdiction and measure identifier history, delisting coverage, pagination and parser, identity, timing, scope, stage, exposure and source-acceptance tests using no factor, comparator, security-price or return values

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: government_subsidy_grant_and_clawback_lifecycle_domain_scout
finite_prevalue_catalog.economic_state: An issuer government grant, subsidy, industrial-support award, conditional disbursement, performance obligation, clawback or repayment state.
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: The bounded repository search found an existing government-subsidy disclosure-intensity mechanism audit, data contract and acceptance record. Reframing it as grant lifecycle, conditional support or clawback would not create an independent Campaign180 mechanism.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: corporate_litigation_arbitration_and_contingent_legal_liability_domain_scout
finite_prevalue_catalog.economic_state: An issuer lawsuit, arbitration, judicial claim, hearing, judgment, appeal, settlement, enforcement and contingent legal-liability lifecycle.
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: Prior immutable records explicitly close switching the terminal CNInfo guarantee and major-contract transport family to lawsuit counts. Reopening the same source family under a wider legal label would be a post-source rescue.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: export_control_sanctions_entity_list_and_trade_authorization_state
finite_prevalue_catalog.economic_state: A close-known issuer trade-authorization state linking controlled product or technology, destination, end user, sanctions designation, licensing requirement, exemption, wind-down, removal and appeal to the affected legal entity.
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: No admitted point-in-time source connects authoritative designation and authorization history, controlled classification, affected party, issuer and subsidiary mapping, destination and end-use scope, effective interval, license or exemption, removal, appeal, correction and trading-session availability for the full 2019-2023 universe.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: antidumping_countervailing_safeguard_investigation_and_order_state
finite_prevalue_catalog.economic_state: A close-known issuer trade-remedy state covering petition, investigation, sampling, preliminary and final findings, duty or undertaking, review, appeal, expiry and revocation for a covered product and origin.
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: The repository lacks a complete case-level history linking authority, product and origin scope, exporter and producer identity, issuer mapping, investigated period, company-specific or residual duty, stage changes, reviews, undertakings, appeals, corrections and first-public timing.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: tariff_quota_origin_classification_and_preferential_eligibility_state
finite_prevalue_catalog.economic_state: A close-known issuer border-treatment state linking product classification and origin to tariff, tariff-rate quota, allocation, preference, exclusion, expiry and customs-ruling changes.
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: No accepted source preserves versioned classification and origin rules, product-to-issuer exposure, bilateral or multilateral schedule, quota allocation and utilization, exclusions, effective dates, corrections and complete historical denominator coverage without current-product leakage.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: customs_import_export_restriction_detention_seizure_and_release_state
finite_prevalue_catalog.economic_state: A close-known issuer customs-action state covering import or export restriction, shipment detention, seizure, forced return, release, remediation, settlement and appeal for a mapped legal entity and product.
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: No complete point-in-time registry or filing chain maps customs authority, case, shipment and product to issuer and subsidiary, legal basis, restriction scope, detention or seizure amount, remediation, release, settlement, appeal, correction and trading-session availability.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: tax_license_penalty_geography_contract_or_security_price_trade_exposure_relabeling
finite_prevalue_catalog.economic_state: An existing tax, operating-license, enforcement, geographic revenue, customer or supplier, contract, commodity-price or security-price state relabeled as international trade restriction exposure.
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: Tax expense, general business license, enforcement event, geographic sales, contract counterparty, commodity path or security price does not identify an authoritative trade measure, covered party and product, origin and destination, stage, legal scope, effective interval, exemption, appeal or removal.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: trade_measure_direction_stage_rate_exposure_denominator_window_or_subset_variant
finite_prevalue_catalog.economic_state: A direction, transform or subset of designation, investigation, duty, tariff, quota, license, detention, removal, affected revenue, cost, geography, product, peer or event-window state.
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: Choosing restriction as good or bad, preliminary versus final stage, high or low duty, direct versus indirect exposure, revenue or cost denominator, jurisdiction, product subset, successful appeals only, lag or event window before source admission would multiply hypotheses and introduce survivorship.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: combined_export_control_sanctions_trade_remedy_tariff_quota_and_customs_score_or_model
finite_prevalue_catalog.economic_state: A joint issuer international-trade score across export control, sanctions, trade remedies, tariffs, quotas, origin rules and customs restrictions or releases.
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: Combining four unadmitted heterogeneous source families or choosing ranks, weights, interactions, filters, subsets or models would expand the search before any component has a complete point-in-time source contract.

scientific_interpretation.safe_conclusion: Two earlier scouts are closed by existing frozen mechanisms; four distinct trade-policy lifecycle states remain deferred at source admission; relabeling, premature operator search and unadmitted combinations are closed before values.
